response.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS account_average FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_figures AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_average) AS figure FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS average_figure FROM region_figures), above_average AS (SELECT r.region, r.figure, o.average_figure FROM region_figures AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE r.figure > o.average_figure) SELECT region, figure, figure - average_figure AS excess, figure / (SELECT AVG(figure) FROM above_average) AS ratio_to_above_average FROM above_average ORDER BY region;
